title: mskilab-org/nf-jabba pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

patient.errorMessage: Patient ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

sample.errorMessage: Sample ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces

status.errorMessage: Status can only be 0 (normal) or 1 (tumor). Defaults to 0, if none is supplied.

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

table.errorMessage: Recalibration table cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.table'

cram.errorMessage: CRAM file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.cram'

bam.errorMessage: BAM file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam'

bam_chimera_filtered.errorMessage: FFPE Chimera-filtered BAM file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.bam'

qc_dup_rate.errorMessage: EstimateLibraryComplexity file and must have extension '.metrics'

qc_dup_rate_tumor.errorMessage: Tumor EstimateLibraryComplexity file and must have extension '.metrics'

qc_dup_rate_normal.errorMessage: Normal EstimateLibraryComplexity file and must have extension '.metrics'

qc_insert_size.errorMessage: Picard MultipleMetrics insert size file must have extension '.metrics'

qc_insert_size_tumor.errorMessage: Tumor Picard MultipleMetrics insert size file must have extension '.metrics'

qc_insert_size_normal.errorMessage: Normal Picard MultipleMetrics insert size file must have extension '.metrics'

qc_alignment_summary.errorMessage: Picard MultipleMetrics alignment summary file and must have extension '.metrics'

qc_alignment_summary_tumor.errorMessage: Tumor Picard MultipleMetrics alignment summary file and must have extension '.metrics'

qc_alignment_summary_normal.errorMessage: Normal Picard MultipleMetrics alignment summary file and must have extension '.metrics'

qc_coverage_metrics.errorMessage: Picard CollectWGSMetrics file must have extension '.metrics'

qc_coverage_metrics_tumor.errorMessage: Tumor Picard CollectWGSMetrics file must have extension '.metrics'

qc_coverage_metrics_normal.errorMessage: Normal Picard CollectWGSMetrics file must have extension '.metrics'

msi.errorMessage: MSI somatic file must be a text file

msi_germline.errorMessage: MSI germline file must be a text file

hets.errorMessage: Pileups file and must have extension '.txt'

amber_dir.errorMessage: Amber directory must be a valid path to a directory

frag_cov.errorMessage: COV file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.rds' or '.txt'

dryclean_cov.errorMessage: COV file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.rds' or '.txt'

cobalt_dir.errorMessage: Cobalt directory must be a valid path to a directory

purple_pp_best_fit.errorMessage: Purple PP Best Fit file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.tsv'

purple_pp_best_fit_revised.errorMessage: Revised Purple PP Best Fit file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.tsv'

purple_pp_range.errorMessage: Purple PP Range file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.tsv'

purple_use_svs.errorMessage: purple_use_svs sample level parameter must be boolean

min_purity_limit.errorMessage: min purity limit must be a number

max_purity_limit.errorMessage: max purity limit must be a number

min_ploidy_limit.errorMessage: min ploidy limit must be a number

max_ploidy_limit.errorMessage: max ploidy limit must be a number

seg.errorMessage: SEG file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.rds'

nseg.errorMessage: NSEG file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.rds'

vcf.errorMessage: VCF file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.vcf' or '.vcf.gz' or '.rds'

sv_tumor_only_rds.errorMessage: SV tumor-only filtered RDS file and must have extension '.rds'

vcf_raw.errorMessage: VCF raw file cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.vcf' or '.vcf.gz' or '.rds'
